description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

The aethyric winds seem drawn to you and you move as if constantly toyed with by playful winds, your clothes and hair buffeted by strange currents - drifting upwards and moving against the natural winds. It all looks quite disturbing. You can, with an Average (+20) Willpower Test, make the wind do small things making it blow slightly less or more within Willpower yards. You may also, with a successful Challenging (+0) Willpower create a gust of wind that can fill a sail, cleanse a room of small detritus or try to topple an object or stun an opponent. Replace Strength bonus with your Willpower Bonus for those feats. You may perform your power as an Extended Test if you like. Stunning an Opponent requires a successful Opposed Test. Fumbling when using your power causes a @Table[minormis]{Minor Miscast}.
